Patchset pushed as Gerrit change 1932 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1932). The amend regenerated the Change-Id, so it landed as a new change rather than a patchset on 1931; 1931 is ABANDONED with a note pointing at 1932, so only one change is open.

Validation for 1932, covering the whole default suite this time (the gap that let patchset 1 through):
  tests/unit + tests/golden        11306 passed
  tests/scripts + tests/lib         1047 passed
  tests/interfaces + tests/e2e      1948 passed   <- the tier that caught both bugs
  config/jira/module_size subset      964 passed  (re-run after the fix)
  make lint 0, make typecheck 0

config.py 658 LOC (142 under the locked 800 cap, below the 720 near-cap band); _config_writer.py 196 LOC.
